Oahu|Ka‘a‘awa.name: Ka‘a‘awa, Honolulu County (windward O‘ahu)
Oahu|Ka‘a‘awa.why: Nominatim matched O'awa Street in Makakilo, Kapolei, on the opposite side of the island. Coordinates of the community of Ka‘a‘awa.

Oahu|Kaiko‘o's Cromwell's Beach.name: Cromwell's Beach, Kāhala, Honolulu (OpenStreetMap)
Oahu|Kaiko‘o's Cromwell's Beach.why: Unlocated as written (Kaiko‘o's is the surf break off Cromwell's Beach). OSM has the beach under "Cromwell's".

Molokai|west-northwest of Pāpōhako Beach.name: Kaiwi Channel, 12 miles west-northwest of Papohaku Beach (computed)
Molokai|west-northwest of Pāpōhako Beach.why: Open water, given as "approx 12 miles west-northwest of Pāpōhako Beach". Computed 12 statute miles at a bearing of 292.5° from Papohaku Beach (OSM, 21.1693, -157.2586; DLNR spells it Pāpōhako).

Maui|Wailea Beach Point.name: Wailea Point, Wailea, Maui (OpenStreetMap)
Maui|Wailea Beach Point.why: Unlocated as written. OSM has the point as "Wailea Point".

Lanai|Po‘aīwa Beach.name: Poaiwa, Lāna‘i (OpenStreetMap)
Lanai|Po‘aīwa Beach.why: Unlocated with diacritics and "Beach". OSM has the place as "Poaiwa", on the Shipwreck Beach shore.

Maui|Pali scenic lookout.name: Papawai Point scenic lookout, Honoapi‘ilani Highway pali, Maui (OpenStreetMap)
Maui|Pali scenic lookout.why: "Pali scenic lookout" is the lookout on the Honoapi‘ilani Highway cliffs between Mā‘alaea and Olowalu. Papawai Point is that lookout; McGregor Point, the other candidate, is 1.5 km away, which cannot change a 50 km count.

Kauai|Pīla‘a Beach.name: Pila'a Beach, Kaua‘i (USGS Anahola topo map, via TopoZone)
Kauai|Pīla‘a Beach.why: Not in OpenStreetMap. Coordinates from the USGS place name on the Anahola topographic map.

Hawaii|northwest of ‘Upolu Pt.name: Open water 10 miles northwest of ‘Upolu Point (computed)
Hawaii|northwest of ‘Upolu Pt.why: Given as "approx 10 miles northwest of ‘Upolu Pt". Computed 10 statute miles at a bearing of 315° from ‘Upolu Point (OSM, 20.2685, -155.8507).

Lanai|Club Lāna‘i.name: Halepalaoa Landing, Lāna‘i (OpenStreetMap)
Lanai|Club Lāna‘i.why: Club Lāna‘i was the day-use beach resort at Halepalaoa on Lāna‘i's east shore; its remains are on the ocean side of Halepalaoa Landing.

Kauai|Brennecke's Beach.name: Brennecke Beach, Po‘ipū, Kaua‘i (OpenStreetMap)
Kauai|Brennecke's Beach.why: Unlocated with the possessive. OSM has it as "Brennecke Beach".

Oahu|Mokulua Island.name: Mokulua Islands, off Lanikai, Kailua (OpenStreetMap)
Oahu|Mokulua Island.why: Unlocated in the singular. OSM has the pair as "Mokulua Islands"; the incident was in the back lagoon between them and the shore.
